reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address ALD overlayers, oxygen vacancies, selective barriers, or physical protection mechanisms. E1 discusses NO adsorption on a bare HEA, and E2 describes a synthesis method for MEA nanoparticles, neither supporting the key premises of the proposed intervention.
premises: ALD oxide overlayers can be deposited as ultrathin, conformal, porous coatings on catalysts
Oxygen vacancies in oxide overlayers facilitate low-temperature oxidation
Oxide overlayers can act as selective barriers against poisoning species like H2O and NO
Conformal oxide coatings physically protect catalyst surfaces from structural degradation
Doped zirconia or CeO2–ZrO2 composites are suitable materials for such overlayers
